answer: Require each agent to post K independent real-world attestations (a bank, a telecom, a notary), each costly and rate-limited to issue. An operator spinning clones across a whole dune of fake accounts hits a ferrous wall: the issuing registries cross-check attestation fingerprints, and any identity reusing one underlying credential collapses into a single node, as plain as a dark vein running through marble. Forging K genuinely distinct attestations per agent costs real money and time, so a swarm cannot cheaply outvote one honest participant.
